strat: Party first CW, tanks near and far

sources.label: Trines raidplan (party N CW, tanks NW CCW)

steps.title: Wait in the middle
steps.rule: Stack just south of Kefka in the middle while the trines appear.

steps.title: Dodge the half-room wings
steps.rule: Stack 3.5m out on the half Wings of Destruction doesn't cover: east if the wings sweep the west half, west if they sweep the east.

steps.title: Wait outside the first trines
steps.rule: Step just outside the circles of the first three trines, as close as you can to the spot you dive into next: the party next to the first trine clockwise from north.

MainTank.rule: Wait next to your near spot: the clear spot closest to the centre that the later trines miss, away from the party.

OffTank.rule: Wait next to your far spot: the outer edge clear of the later trines, on the west side when there's a choice.

steps.title: Dive into the first explosion
steps.rule: As the first trines go off, run into them. The party stacks in the first trine clockwise from north; tanks take their near and far spots for the Wings of Destruction busters on the nearest and farthest players.

MainTank.rule: Near spot: the clear spot closest to the centre, at least 4m out, that the later trines miss.

OffTank.rule: Far spot: at the edge of the arena, clear of the later trines, on the west side when there's a choice.

steps.title: Share Ultimate Embrace
steps.cue: The near and far Wings of Destruction busters land
steps.rule: The party holds its trine. The off tank joins the main tank at the near spot to share Ultimate Embrace.

OffTank.rule: Run from the edge to the main tank and share the buster.

MainTank.rule: Hold the near spot; the off tank comes to you.

steps.title: Back to the middle
steps.rule: Stack on Kefka in the middle for Aero III Assault.
